translation.name: Jesucristo oy oa’pak: Kenda Jesucristoa; monigka’uyatenok; Diostaj mo’manopo’yarea’ika’ne

book.name: SAN MARCOS
book.title: SAN MARCOS Marcosa Jesucristoen huadak huaʼa oʼmanigmadoyaʼuyate.

content: Jesúsa ebaʼpoʼketpaktaj oʼbaʼyareaʼuyate.
Onteʼti okmapi̱e̱ʼahuaddik huameʼnoete judíoen hua̱i̱takeʼ jakyo Jesúsa oʼkuduyate. Ke̱yo̱ huabokerek ebaʼpoʼketpak o̱ʼu̱yate.

“¿Okmapi̱e̱ʼahuaddik huameʼnoete menpaʼ Jesúsa yaʼyareapo?” Fariseo onʼnopo̱e̱po, eʼyareaʼnayo, “Jesúsa dakhueaʼ oʼkaʼ.” Huaaʼdik o̱ʼe̱y onʼnopo̱e̱ʼuyate. Konige̱po fariseo Jesústaj onʼtiahuayaʼuyate.
—‍Yaboʼ, i̱yo̱ eretnopoyo yaboatoʼ. —‍Jesúsa ebaʼpoʼketpaktaj onaʼuyate.

—‍¿Okmapi̱e̱ʼahuaddik huameʼnoete menpaʼ huadak kaʼdik ya̱ʼne? ¿Menpaʼ dakhueaʼ kaʼdik ya̱ʼne? ¿Menpaʼ yareaʼdik ya̱ʼne? ¿Menpaʼ arakdik ya̱ʼne? —‍Jesúsa oʼmanaʼnigʼa. Fariseomeya̱ sohuataʼ aʼtokhueʼda oʼnoke̱ʼuyate.
Eʼnopoenkaʼtaʼ pakhueʼ o̱ʼnenok Jesúsa oʼbahuadiayonpo suhueʼda o̱ʼe̱po nogta nogta oʼbatiahuaypo, —‍Yabateʼ. —‍Jesúsa onaʼuyate. Ken oʼbaʼtepo oʼbaʼyarudʼuyate.
Fariseomey oʼnoro̱kpo i̱da Herodestaj huapakeriere o̱gkupopakdepo, menpaʼ Jesústaj arakdik o̱ʼe̱, onʼbatiaʼpakuyate.
E̱ʼpo̱g aktaʼbogpete Jesústaj huakkaʼda o̱gkupopakuyate.
Huaboroʼ e̱ʼpo̱g aktaʼbogpeyo Jesús huanigpe̱i̱kaʼeriere onʼhuaʼuyate. Huakkaʼ Galilea huadaribayaʼ hua̱e̱ʼerikon onʼtahuaʼuyate.
Judeayaʼ Jerusalénya̱ʼ Idumea huadariyaʼ Jordánhue̱ adpenyaʼ Tiro huakkaʼ jakyaʼ Sidón huakkaʼ jakyaʼ huakkaʼda onʼhuatiakpo, Jesúsa ʼurunanada oʼkikaʼ onʼtipe̱e̱depo, onʼtiakuyate.

Huakkaʼtada oʼbayareaduynok ayaʼada dakhueʼ hua̱e̱ʼeria aʼyareyaʼpo kenʼtaj eʼnejtaʼ onʼpakpo diga̱ʼda onʼkupopakpo Jesússo̱ʼtaj sapajdikte eʼnenok, —‍Ibodteda kusiʼpe moʼnigto̱e̱ʼ. —‍Jesúsa huanigpe̱i̱kaʼeritaj oʼmanaʼuyate.
Kenokaʼ totoʼa huanopoʼto̱e̱ʼeria Jesústaj onʼtiahuaydepo onʼtihue̱kpo, —‍Diosen Huasiʼpo i̱ʼe̱ne. —‍ʼUttaʼda oʼnonaʼuyate.
—‍Kejeʼ mati̱o̱ki̱a̱hueʼ yaneʼ. —‍I̱ghuaʼda oʼmanaʼuyate Jesúsa.
Jesúsa docetaj huamataʼmonaʼ oʼbaktieʼeaʼuyate.
Oteʼyo oʼbehuikuyate. Kenomeytaj eʼbaktieʼeaʼtaʼ oʼpakpo “Yanʼtiak,” oʼmanaʼnok onʼhuatiakuyate.
Jesúsere kaʼnikeʼpo huadak huaʼa kanʼmanmadikikeʼpo docetaj oʼbaktieʼeaʼuyate.
“Do ijpaknok dakhueʼ e̱e̱ʼ bayareaʼdik moʼe̱a̱po kenpaʼti dakhueʼ noki̱re̱gtaj maoro̱kaʼdik moʼe̱a̱pone.” Oʼmanaʼuyate.
Jesúsen doce huamataʼmoneri o̱ʼnepo: Simón Pedro,
Jacobo, Jacoboen huamaʼbuy Juan Zebedeoen huasiʼpo, kenomeytaj oʼdikkaʼ Boanerges (kurud eaʼensiʼpo),
Andrés, Felipe, Bartolomé, Mateo, Tomás, Jacobo Alfeoen huasiʼpo, Tadeo, Simón cananista huakupopakeri,

kenpaʼti Judas Iscariote Jesúsen huamataʼmoneri o̱ʼnuyate. Judas Iscariote huakupete Jesústaj kanarakeʼpo yaʼbahuatitotiakapet. “Totoʼ huairia Jesústaj oʼteyyaʼ.” Fariseo huamanmadikaʼeria namaʼda onʼhuaaʼuyate. (Mt. 12.22-32; Lc. 11.14-23; 12.10) Nogok huanigpe̱i̱kaʼeri Jesúsere jakyo onʼkuduyate.
Onteʼti huakkaʼda aratbut o̱gkupopaknok menpaʼ bapehueʼdik o̱ʼneʼuyate.
“Oʼsegpakpo oʼkikaʼ.” Aratbuta onʼbatiaʼpaknok Jesúsen huabeta kenda onʼnopo̱e̱depo aʼtohuayaʼpo onʼhuatiakuyate.
—‍Beelzebú totoʼ huairi oʼnopoʼto̱e̱po oʼteyyaʼnok Jesúsa totoʼ noki̱re̱gtaj oʼmakenikaʼ. —‍Moisésenbaʼ huamanmadikaʼeria onʼbatiaʼpakuy. Jerusalénya̱ʼ onʼtiakdeʼuyate.

“Namaʼda onʼnopo̱e̱nig Moisésenbaʼ huamanmadikaʼeritaj aʼmanopo̱e̱a̱yaʼpo menhuatiakpo menʼpe̱e̱ʼ,” Jesúsa oʼmanaʼdepo konig o̱ʼe̱ oʼmanbatiaʼpakpo: —‍Menpaʼ totoʼa huataʼ totoʼtaj enʼdik ya̱ʼe̱t. Ehueʼ, enhueʼdik o̱ʼe̱.
Ondariyoyoʼ hua̱e̱ʼeri gobierno huairi huayahuaya eʼbarakikaʼnayo gobierno huairi to̱e̱hueʼdik o̱ʼneapo.
Kenpaʼti onyoyoʼ hua̱e̱ʼeri eʼbatuktuktaʼ onʼpakpo onʼbakkupopak. Eʼbaraknayo ehueʼdikda o̱ʼne.
Konigti totoʼ huairi huayahuaya eʼmagkaʼnayo aʼti ehueʼdik ya̱ʼneapet.

Huabokereka huairien eʼtamaikaʼ jekbakaytaʼ eʼpaknayo baʼtinukuʼdik kenpaʼti itakpiʼtinukuʼdik o̱ʼe̱. Huairitaj oʼtinukudepo okbakaydik o̱ʼe̱. Donayo teyda i̱jje̱y. Totoʼ huairitaj tinukuʼdik i̱jje̱y. Totoʼ huairien huanabaʼ maendik i̱jje̱y.
Aratbut dakhueaʼda ekaʼnayo kenpaʼti Diostaj dakhueaʼda eʼhuaaʼnayo nopoʼtihuekeʼdik o̱ʼe̱ Diosa.

Diosen Noki̱re̱gtanayo dakhueaʼda eʼhuaaʼnayo Diosa bakkahueahueʼdik o̱ʼe̱. Menokapiʼ bokkahueahueʼ o̱ʼe̱a̱po Diosa. Diosen Noki̱re̱gtaj dakhueaʼda oʼhuaaʼuyate Diosa okkahuehueʼ o̱ʼunhuahuikaʼapo. Buttida ijjay. —‍Jesúsa oʼmanaʼuyate.
“Dakhueaʼ noki̱re̱ga̱ Jesústaj oʼnopoʼto̱e̱.” Moisésenbaʼ huamanmadikaʼeria namaʼda onʼhuaaʼnok Jesúsa kenpaʼ oʼmanaʼuyate.
Jesúsen hua̱ye̱ Jesúsen huamaʼbuyere onʼhuatiakuyate.
Kenokaʼ hua̱ye̱ Jesúsen huamaʼbuyere onʼhuatiakuynigʼa huakkaʼnada o̱gkupopaknok bidtemon onʼboatoʼpo “boʼhuatiakne. Yanaʼ,” onaʼnok
huakkaʼda aratbut onʼtikupohuadpo, —‍O̱ʼnen hua̱ye̱ o̱ʼnen huamaʼbuyere aratbuttiokpeyon moʼnigbone. Onʼtaj boʼukne. —‍Oʼnonaʼuyate.
—‍Be doʼhued hua̱ye̱ ya̱ʼe̱t. Doʼhued huamaʼbuy be ya̱ʼnet. —‍Jesúsa oʼmanaʼpo,
kenomey enʼtikupohuadtaj oʼtiokpokubereʼpo, —‍Inomey doʼhued hua̱ye̱ doʼhued huamaʼbuy o̱ʼne.
Kenda Dios oʼpaknok ayaʼada o̱gkikaʼpo doʼhued huamaʼbuy doʼhued huaidpo doʼhued hua̱ye̱ o̱ʼne. —‍Jesúsa oʼmanaʼuyate.
